messages:
Priya: heads-up — nightly eval convo_v2 shows a sharp quality regression for rwd-3b-q4f :eyes:
ci-bot: nightly-run finished: https://ci.internal/nightly/1770000011 (summary attached)
Priya: metrics: mean ROUGE down 9%, accuracy on intent prompts down 12%, and a jump in hallucination cases flagged by the eval harness. No obvious data drift in prompts.
Mike: did the run use the new narrow-batching config we rolled out yesterday?
Priya: yes, narrowed batch size from 32->8 for latency, plus we enabled prefix cache prefetch for short-prefix optimization.
Oliver: hmm that screams prefix-key aliasing. We saw similar nondeterminism when the cache key salt was omitted for model variants.
Nora: repro quickly: can someone paste the eval command?
Priya: ```
# nightly eval command
./tools/eval --model rwd-3b-q4f --promptset conv_v2 --batching narrow --cache-prefetch on --seed 2026
```
Mike: repro note: when I re-ran locally with cache-prefetch off, metrics match baseline. With prefetch on, outputs diverge and some prompts return responses from other conversations (clearly stale prefix hits).
Priya: attaching a short log snippet where the cache key collision appears:
```
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] cache.get key=pf:tenant_42:shorthash(0x7a1b)
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] cache.hit -> entry.model_variant=rwd-3b-q2a (mismatch)
[2026-03-18T03:12:05Z] served from cache (wrong attach) -> downstream hallucination
```
Oliver: that line nails it: cache hit returns entry for q2a (different quantization/config) — our cache key shorthash is colliding across model variants. That would explain quality drop.
Mike: why did this only show up after narrow-batching?
Oliver: narrow-batching changed request interleaving and prefetch timing — which increases the window where a shorthash collision leads to a cross-tenant/variant hit before TTL eviction. Basically more temporal overlap.
Priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable cache-prefetch for q4f until fixed; 2) widen cache key to include full model_variant string (short-term); 3) add per-model salt in key derivation; 4) add strict model-variant tag to cache entries and assert on mismatch. Thoughts?
Mike: agree. I can flip config to disable prefetch for rwd-3b-q4f and push a key-change patch. Which to do first?
Oliver: disable prefetch first (fast rollback). Then bump key (risky but clean). Also add a quick canary: nightly eval should include a deterministic sample set that asserts no cross-variant hits.
Nora: I'll add an eval check that scans logs for 'cache.hit -> entry.model_variant!=' and fail the job if seen. Small PR incoming.
Priya: owner assignments: Mike -> rollback prefetch & key-change patch, Oliver -> write unit test for key derivation + per-entry variant assert, Nora -> add log detector in nightly harness. I'll open a ticket to track.
Mike: pushing config change now. ETA ~15m.
ci-bot: deploy queued: change-set 94321 (prefetch disable for rwd-3b-q4f), status: in-progress
Priya: also investigating root cause of shorthash collision — looks like we used a 32-bit truncated hash for cache keys to save memory; collisions are plausible at scale. Need product decision on key size vs memory.
Oliver: long-term we should migrate to keyed cache namespace per-model and use 128-bit hashes if we keep memory for metadata. I'll draft cost/benefit.
Mike: deployed — prefetch disabled; rerunning nightly subset now.
ci-bot: nightly-subset run started: https://ci.internal/nightly/1770000011/subset
Priya: thanks. If the subset looks good we'll do a full rerun tomorrow. Also tagging @infra for a follow-up on cache metadata sizing.
Nora: PR for log detector: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/pulls/4221 — adds assert and a failing test to catch variant mismatches.
Priya: great. Postmortem checklist: reproduce locally, rollback prefetch (done), widen key or salt, add nightly detector, decide on metadata memory budget, schedule proper migration and announce to ENG.
Mike: noted. Any chance this affects Dedicated customers?
Oliver: possible if they enabled prefetch and share cache namespaces. We'll scan dedicated configs and notify CS if needed.
Priya: cool — I'll draft a short incident note for #incidents if the full rerun is red. For now monitoring. :thumbsup:
